title: WildinSync - eDNA Sampling of Marine Coastal Areas
author: Andrea Polanco
materials: Follow the specific protocol for the procedure.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Establish a clean, dedicated workspace using a bleach-cleaned plastic tray, ensuring no one enters the water during the process to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Set up a Naturelink peristaltic pump at a height to prevent water exposure; secure with snap hooks and rope if on a boat.
Prepare one tubing kit (tubing and capsule) and a set of three labels (stickers).
Clean the outer packaging of the tubing kit and any scissors/penknives with bleach.
Open the tubing kit packaging without removing the contents.
Put on the provided nitrile gloves; do not touch skin, clothes, or other equipment after donning.

steps.title: Assemble Filtration System
steps.instruction: Assemble the filtration capsule and tubing while maintaining sterility of the strainer and capsule ends.

substeps.instruction: Clean scissors/penknife with bleach wipes followed by alcohol to open the inner capsule bag.
Peek out the upper part of the capsule without removing it entirely from the bag.
Screw the threaded end of the hose onto the top end of the capsule and secure well.
Unlock the peristaltic pump head and position the hose inside, ensuring the arrow on the pump indicates the correct water flow direction toward the capsule.
Lock the pump head.
Connect the battery, securing it in a dry bag if necessary.

steps.title: Perform eDNA Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter 30 L of water or run for the allotted time using the peristaltic pump.

substeps.instruction: Position the strainer suspended in the water, ensuring it does not touch the substrate.
Remove the capsule from the bag, keeping the drain vertical and clear of any contact.
If on a boat, optionally attach the tube to a fishing line with a lead sinker using duct tape to keep the strainer submerged.
Start the pump and record the start time and coordinates on the field sheet.
If performing a boat transect, maintain a speed of approximately 3 knots; recommended pump settings are 50% speed for 1 hour.
Monitor flow; if the membrane clogs due to turbidity, stop and note the filtered volume.
If the membrane is not fully covered by water, slow the pump and carefully unscrew the overpressure valve on top of the capsule until covered.
To calibrate flow rate (target < 1 L·min^-1), time how long it takes to fill a 0.5/1 L container; adjust strength with button '2' and duration with button '3'.

steps.title: Purge and Recover Capsule
steps.instruction: Empty the remaining seawater from the system before preservative addition.

substeps.instruction: With the pump still on, remove the strainer from the water (without touching it) and allow air to pass through the hose to empty the capsule.
Switch off the pump.
Turn the capsule over to help remove residual water.
Unscrew the pump head and remove the hose, ensuring the unprotected lower end of the capsule does not touch anything.

steps.title: Preserve the Sample
steps.instruction: Inject preservation buffer into the capsule to secure the eDNA.

substeps.instruction: Clean scissors/penknife with bleach followed by alcohol.
Open the buffer kit and remove the screw cap from the buffer container.
Unscrew the hose from the capsule and immediately screw the buffer container onto the capsule.
Slowly unscrew the pressure valve of the capsule to allow air to escape.
Keeping the capsule upright, slowly pour the entire contents of the buffer syringe into the capsule, regulating inflow with the valve cap.
Secure the top of the capsule with the remaining cap.
Vigorously move the capsule up and down for at least 30 seconds to ensure the buffer permeates the filter.

steps.title: Label and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Properly identify and store the samples to prevent degradation.

substeps.instruction: Label the capsule with sticker n°1.
Place the capsule in a plastic bag (preferably numbered) and store it in a box.
Label the box with sticker n°2.
Label the associated metadata on the field sheet with sticker n°3.
Store the box in a dark place at room temperature; avoid large temperature variations.
Do not use a refrigerator or freezer for storage.
